The [preview deck](preview.html) is built by this site.
This page is the source behind it.

## The front matter

```yaml
---
title: "The storybook theme"
subtitle: "A deck built by the documentation site"
author: "Mickaël CANOUIL"
institute: "An institute"
date: last-modified
format: storybook-revealjs
---
```

The title slide is laid out from those keys alone.

## A logo and a footer

```yaml
format:
  storybook-revealjs:
    logo: logo.svg
    footer: "An event, somewhere"
    slide-number: true
```

All three are RevealJS options; the theme styles where they land.
The format turns the slide number off, so `slide-number: true` is what brings it back.

## A background image

```markdown
# Chapter 1 {background-image="background.jpg"}
```

`background.jpg` ships with the format, so a slide can name it without your adding a file.
Name your own file there to use that instead.
The title slide already carries the shipped `cover.jpg` without your asking for it.

## Ordinary slides

```markdown
## A slide

- A list item.
- Another one.

\`\`\`r
summary(cars)
\`\`\`
```

Nothing on a slide is marked up for the theme: headings, lists, code, and tables are styled as they come.

## Incremental content

```markdown
::: {.incremental}

- Revealed in turn.
- As usual.

:::
```

RevealJS fragments and incremental lists behave as they do in any deck.
